help_menu:
ᴄʟɪᴄᴋ ᴛʜᴇ ʙᴜᴛᴛᴏɴs ʙᴇʟᴏᴡ ᴛᴏ ɢᴇᴛ ɪɴғᴏʀᴍᴀᴛɪᴏɴ ᴀʙᴏᴜᴛ ᴍʏ ᴄᴏᴍᴍᴀɴᴅs.
𝐍ᴏᴛᴇ: All commands can be used with /
help_admins: 👮 Admin commands: 🔹 /pause: Puase the ongoing stream. 🔹 /resume: Resume the paused stream. 🔹 /skip: Skip the current stream. 🔹 /stop: Stop the ongoing stream. 🔹 /seek [seconds]: Seek the ongoing stream forward. 🔹 /seekback [seconds]: Seek the ongoing stream backward. 🔹 /reload: Reloads the admin cache.
help_auth: 🔐 Auth commands: Authorized users can control the ongoing stream without being an admin. 🔹 /auth: Add a user to the authorized users list. 🔹 /unauth: Remove a user from the authorized users list.
help_blist: 🚫 Blacklist commands: Blacklisted chats and users cannot use the bot. 🔹 /blacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Add a chat/user to the blacklist. 🔹 /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Remove a chat/user from the blacklist
help_lang: 🌐 Language commands: This bot supports multiple languages. 🔹 /lang: Change the language of the bot.
help_ping: 📡 Ping commands: 🔹 /help: Shows the help menu of the bot. 🔹 /ping: Check the ping and memory usage of the bot. 🔹 /start: Start the bot. 🔹 /sudolist: Shows the list of sudo users of the bot.
help_play: 🎵 Play commands: You can play music in the video chat using the following commands. 🔹 /play [name/url/reply]: Play music in the video chat. 🔹 /vplay [name/url/reply]: Play music video in the video chat. 🔹 -f: Force play music in the video chat. 🔹 -v: Plays music video in the video chat. 💡 Example: /play -f -v attention
help_queue: 📋 Queue commands: 🔹 /queue: Shows the currently queued tracks in the queue.
help_autoplay: 🤖 Autoplay commands: 🔹 /autoplay [enable|disable]: Toggles the autoplay on/off for the chat.
help_vclog: 🪵 VC Logger commands: 🔹 /vclogger: Toggles the VC join/leave logger on/off for the chat.
help_sudo: ⚡ Sudo commands: 🔹 /ac: Shows the active calls count. 🔹 /activevc: Shows the list of the active calls. 🔹 /broadcast [reply]: Broadcasts the message to all the chats. ⚡ -nochat: Excludes groups from the broadcast. ⚡ -user: Include users in the broadcast. ⚡ -copy: Removes the forwarded tag from the broadcast message. 💡 Example: /broadcast -user -copy 🔹 /eval: Executes the given code. 🔹 /logs: Sends the log file. 🔹 /logger [on|off]: Enables/disables the logger. 🔹 /restart: Restarts the bot. 🔹 /addsudo / /rmsudo: Manage sudo users list.
